activity_summary: At home the supper with Quiney is Monday at six. You paid nothing today toward it. Kemp's tally was shut at the Jackdaw and not before. The three sheets are not a finished play. You are not writing the rest tonight. Anne's letter is still unsent.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said it, and did not go back to the table.

facets.activity: Set Monday supper and left the play at three sheets

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The three sheets are not a play.
